episodes.title: DELETE: LOVE
episodes.summary: A mysterious girl asks Lilly to take her picture with a peculiar phone. Following a brief escape to Koh Chang, Aim and Lilly come back to reality.

episodes.title: DELETE: TRUST
episodes.summary: After a startling revelation, Lilly makes her way to see Aim. Later, Lilly seeks her chance to delete her husband using the strange device she found.

episodes.title: DELETE: FALSENESS
episodes.summary: In her search for Orn, Nicha reaches out to Aim. Meanwhile, a scandalous photo makes the headlines — and catches Too's attention.

episodes.title: DELETE: HATRED
episodes.summary: June finds herself in a confrontation with a schoolmate, Tong. She finds comfort when she confides in Lilly about her troubles in boarding school.

episodes.title: DELETE: TRUTH
episodes.summary: An unknown person questions Too in search of the lost phone. Police visit June's school to investigate the whereabouts of a missing student.

episodes.title: DELETE: PAIN
episodes.summary: In the middle of the night, Lilly sneaks out to see Aim. Caught in a bind, Lilly discovers more about the girl she encountered at the supermarket.

episodes.title: DELETE: RAGE
episodes.summary: Too goes in pursuit of the person who last saw Lilly. Later, Aim is taken aback by an unexpected development.

episodes.title: DELETE: SECRETS
episodes.summary: Wracked with guilt, Aim has a confession to make. In the end, he makes a difficult final decision.
